name: Kisaragi Chikage
source: A promising new student that fights like a shinobi. She is a hard-working that is highly confidant, and look down on those with no talents. She admires her mother, who is a skilled swordsmen, but disdain that she retired in order to become a mother. Because of this, she dresses as a man as a symbol of her abandoning her femininity.
